description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average hidden state mean values across different layers of a model, with three distinct lines representing different conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linear and ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," starting at approximately 0.71 and showing a gradual increase with some fluctuations, reaching a peak near 4 at the 20th layer. The orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," starting at approximately 0.05 and remaining relatively flat with slight variations, ending at the same value at the 20th layer. The green solid line represents the "hidden state," which remains constant at 0 across all layers.
